correctness.rationale: Exact Gram representation and determinant 2u1²u2²u3² checked by algebra and exact-rational 66-simplex grid. Compactness gives uniform λ2>0, and row-sum identity ensures λmax≤1. Off-axis tubular neighborhoods yield only O(sqrt(t)). At six axis crossings λmin/(2x²y²)=1+O(ρ²), and the planar |xy|<sqrt(t/2) area is 4a log(1/a)+O(a); squeezing ρ→0 produces sharp 3/(π sqrt(2)). λmax→1 at axes gives same κ coefficient. Layer cake yields exact s<1/2 moment range; Dirichlet integral gives gamma identity. Checked real parameters, boundaries and distinction between finite experiments and infinite proof. Actual decoded verifier recomputed 28,300 assertions; sampling is ancillary.

value.rationale: Directly motivated by a documented diagonal coefficient system in a rank-one low-rank-plus-diagonal tangent projection. The sharp log-enhanced near-singularity coefficient and s=1/2 moment boundary quantify a genuine random-orientation conditioning hazard not given by generic invertibility or Dirichlet determinant moments alone. This enables probabilistic safeguards/robustness characterization for randomized numerical analyses without claiming whole-method instability. No arbitrary parameter slices, routine substitution or known-table recomputation.
